name: s6
description: 20 MMLongBench-Doc questions where PINE (agentic navigator, agent_runs/full_cluster, 18 Oct 2026, Qwen3.5-9B, thinking off; the PINE run of PINE_comparison_report) is wrong and the all-pages-as-images baseline with thinking ON (agent_runs/baseline_all_image_think, Qwen3.5-9B) is right. Wrong/right means agreement of BOTH the rule-based official scorer and the gpt-oss-120b judge. Pool: 166; dropped 1 with gold pages beyond the PDF and 15 near-misses (format-only differences, answers with extra items, premise rejections instead of abstaining). From the remaining 150, one question per document, stratified by answer format (Int 8, Str 4, Float 4, None 2, List 2, roughly proportional to the pool), greedily balancing evidence source and PINE failure mode, seed 20261028. run_id is the run id of the same question in the full runs.
author: PINE project
